title: Voyager 40th Anniversary at Air and Space Museum
description: Suzy Dodd, Voyager project manager, NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, speaks at an event to celebrate the 40th Anniversary of the launch of the Voyager 1 and 2 missions, Tuesday, September 5, 2017 at Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum in Washington. Voyager 1 was launched September 5, 1977,
keywords: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum (NASM)
